verses.verse:
क्वविदर्धं क्वचिच्चांशम् पूर्णम् वावर्तनस्य च।
पूर्यते विविधैस्तानैः गतम् गीतम् च गायकैः।१४१।
verses.text: Sometimes half, sometimes a part, or the whole of an āvartan: singers fill out the gat and the gīt with various tānas.

commentary.text: Taking one round of the tāla as one āvartan (cycle), a gat should be of at least one āvartan; but tānas are sometimes of half an āvartan, sometimes of a quarter of an āvartan, sometimes of three quarters, and so on. So after tānas of an incomplete āvartan, part of the gat is played to complete that āvartan; and sometimes also part of the gat is played to complete the āvartan by means of tihāīs. Tihāīs are of many kinds, from small to large. Their definition is given next.
